# CRITERION-70: A path that does not exist is an error

When a path does not exist, jag names the path on the error stream and exits with code 2, as rg does.

Source of the change from grep to rg: the user, hitl answer of 2026-10-15 (FEATURE-23, Q1 option 1: rg is the reference for jag with no question).
